title: Grateful Dead Live at US Festival, Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
venue: US Festival, Glen Helen Regional Park
lineage: Master Cassettes (JVC KD-A55 w/Super ANRS) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2024 > TLH 2496
source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM-57 mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Nice wide‑spread sound from a compact, high‑energy show captured via Shure SM57s on the board
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a pleasingly spacious mix thanks to the clever use of Shure SM57 cardioids on drum overheads and the bass drum, giving it a classic ’69‑’70 Dead drum feel despite being a modern ’80 festival tape. The band, though allotted limited stage time, managed to channel their 60s vibe into a tight set that many listeners find enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes good sound and an engaging performance; rating reflects solid show quality with a decent board recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Uses Shure SM57 cardioid mics for drum overheads and bass drum (room‑tape style), resulting in a wide, clear spread; no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Limited set time but the band delivered a concise, classic‑era feel that fit well within an ’80s festival lineup.
